usage: Volty Gatling Burst mount sheet; dismount reuses the same frames in reverse.

source.prompt: Volty folds into a compact gatling tank, treads deploy, rotating barrel aims upward, cyan reactor glow, centered 16-bit pixel art, transparent background.

integration.size_match_reference: Volty companion walk/cast draw size is 104px, but tank frame 11 has a taller alpha bbox than Volty's SD frames; runtime uses 96px so the transformed tank reads as the same visual size class.
integration.runtime_frame_policy: Frames 0-11 are used as the Volty-to-tank chassis transform. Frames 12-24 contain an AutoSprite-baked barrel and are intentionally not selected at runtime, because the live skill draws exactly one aimable barrel aligned to bullet direction.
